## funtional forms of diffrent vector feilds
```{r}
# example from Vector Feild interpolation with RFB paper
VF_1 = function(v) c(v[1]*(1/2*v[1]^2+1/2)+v[2]*(-v[1]+(1/2*v[2]-1)*v[2]+1/2),1/2*v[1]^2*v[2]+v[1]*(-1/2*v[2]^2+v[2]-1/2)+1/2*v[2]-1) 

# example of Vector feild with limit cycle using the 
#Van der Pol oscillator
VF_LimitCycle=function(v) c(v[2],.1*(1-v[1]^2)*v[2]-v[1])

VF_StableCycle=function(v) c(v[2],-v[1])

VF_SaddelNode=function(v) c(v[1],-2*v[2])

VF_UnstableNode=function(v) c(v[1]/2,v[2]/2)
```

## numerical integrators
```{r}
forward_euler=function(x0, fun, step_size, n){

  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    path[[i]]=path[[i-1]]+step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
  }
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
}
```

# Simulate the SDE using Euler-Maruyama
```{r}
euler_maryama=function(x0, fun, Q, step_size, n){
  
  path=list(x0)
  x=c(x0[1])
  y=c(x0[2])
  for(i in 2:n){
    temp =path[[i-1]]+step_size*fun(path[[i-1]])
    
    #we need to construct a joint normal distribution and and sample form that if     #the X and y components are not independent
    
    #if they are independent then this works
    suppressWarnings({
      temp_x=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[1,1]*step_size)
      temp_y=rnorm(n = 1, mean = 0, sd = Q[2,2]*step_size)
    })
    temp_x=temp_x+temp[1]
    temp_y=temp_y+temp[2]
    path[[i]] = c(temp_x,temp_y)
    x[i]=path[[i]][1]
    y[i]=path[[i]][2]
    }
  
  path_df=data.frame(
    x=x,
    y=y
  )
  return(path_df)
  }
```

density_map=function(x_vals,y_vals,step){
  
  mu=as.numeric(mean_function[step,])

  # print("covaraince")

  # print("inverse_sig")
  # print(inv_sig)

  det_sig=det(sig)
  # print("det_sig")
  # print(det_sig)
  # print("================")
  map=matrix(ncol = length(x_vals),nrow=length(y_vals))
  for(i in 1:length(x_vals)){
    for(j in 1:length(y_vals)){
      v=c(x_vals[i],y_vals[j])
      map[i,j]=1/(sqrt((2*pi)^2*det_sig))*(exp((-1/2*t(v-mu)%*%inv_sig%*%(v-mu))))
    }
     
  }

  return(map)
}

density_map <- function(x_vals, y_vals, step){

  mu <- as.numeric(mean_function[step,])

  sig <- Q * (step * time_step)

  inv_sig <- solve(sig)
  det_sig <- det(sig)

  # Create grid
  grid <- expand.grid(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

  # Center coordinates
  centered <- sweep(as.matrix(grid), 2, mu)

  # Compute quadratic forms efficiently
  quad <- rowSums((centered %*% inv_sig) * centered)

  # Gaussian density
  dens <- exp(-0.5 * quad) /
    sqrt((2*pi)^2 * det_sig)

  # Convert back to matrix form
  map <- matrix(
    dens,
    nrow = length(y_vals),
    ncol = length(x_vals),
    byrow = FALSE
  )

  return(map)
}


time_step=.01
steps = 100
mean_function=forward_euler(c(-1.3,1.1), VF_1, time_step,steps )

## create diffusion matrix 
sigma_1=.5
sigma_2=.5
Q=matrix(data = c(sigma_1,0,0,sigma_2), nrow = 2, ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE,
       dimnames = NULL)

x_vals <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)
y_vals <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)
  

map=matrix(0,nrow = length(x_vals),ncol=length(y_vals))
for(i in 1:steps){
  
  temp=density_map(x_vals, y_vals, i)
  map=map+temp
  
}

# Define a multivariate function
f <- function(x, y) {
  sin(x) * cos(y)
}

# Create a sequence for x and y axes
x_vals <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)
y_vals <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)

# Generate a grid of all (x, y) combinations
grid_data <- expand.grid(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

# Evaluate the function at each point
grid_data$z <- f(grid_data$x, grid_data$y)
